text:
lee: hitting an odd parity issue between the Node SDK and the browser JS SDK in the next-edge starter. server (node) returns embeddings and eval counts as expected; edge runtime shows responses but Console metrics show zero embeddings.

lee: repro steps:
1) checkout samples/next-edge-embed-starter
2) yarn && vercel dev (edge)
3) call /api/embed -> UI returns vectors, Console shows 0 embed_calls

tara: do you see any network call to telemetry endpoint? sometimes fetch polyfills swallow the telemetry POST in edge.

lee: none. stack shows SDK v0.10.7 in yarn.lock for the fork. template readme says use latest but the lock got stale.

devx-bot: FYI: SDK telemetry for edge fixed in 0.11.0 (see changelog). Recommend pinning in starter to ^0.11.3.

lee: upgraded to 0.11.3 locally and telemetry appears. test note: also needed to remove NEXT_PUBLIC prefix from envs in the example, since that leaked keys to client and caused confusion.

ops: added infra ticket to dedupe ingestion of partial streams when retries happen (ingest-guard-219). retries were inflating usage when auth failed before stream termination.

tara: action items: 1) update starter README to require SDK >=0.11.3, 2) change example to use server-only env names, 3) add a runtime warning when telemetry queue remains empty after a model call, 4) add CI matrix job to run the edge handler and assert telemetry ingestion.

lee: opened PR 2209 with dependency bump and README patch. devx-bot created issue #1610. will link PR to issue.

ops: nice catch. small PSA for starters authors: avoid NEXT_PUBLIC for secrets and keep SDK versions current.
